name: v0.3.0
body:
## Security

This release fixes **CVE-2026-17106** / **[GHSA-hfg8-hc9c-6c3h](https://github.com/moby/go-archive/security/advisories/GHSA-hfg8-hc9c-6c3h)**, where a crafted tar archive could use links to cause extraction operations to create or overwrite files outside the intended destination directory.

The issue affected `Unpack`, `UnpackLayer`, `Untar`, `UntarUncompressed`, and the `ApplyLayer` helpers. Users should upgrade and avoid extracting untrusted archives with earlier versions.

## What's Changed

* archive: harden tar extraction against path traversal https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/45
* archive: do not follow reparse points in chtimes https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/90
* archive: fix creation time updates on Windows https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/79
* archive: minor cleanups and godoc touch-up https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/87
* archive: RebaseArchiveEntries: fix archive path rebasing https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/43

## Test and CI changes

* ci: enable dependabot for actions https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/81
* archive: make breakoutErr unwrap its cause https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/91
* archive: use filepath for filesystem paths in tests https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/80
* archive: use filepath for filesystem paths in tests https://github.com/moby/go-archive/pull/80


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/moby/go-archive/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
